result.title: LIFT: Lifting Language-Controlled Image Fusion to Free-Viewpoint 3D Scenes
result.summary: Multimodal image fusion traditionally generates a single fused image from paired observations at a specific viewpoint, limiting comprehensive scene perception and adaptability to diverse perceptual objectives. To overcome these limitations, we present LIFT, a novel framework for our proposed language-controlled 3D image fusion (L3D-IF) paradigm that extends multimodal image fusion from 2D images to free-viewpoint 3D scenes, enabling language-guided fusion tailored to diverse perceptual objectives. First, LIFT formulates Semantic Modality Binding (SMB), which interprets language instructions to identify semantic targets and their associated modality preferences and grounds these targets in corresponding regions of a shared Gaussian scene, establishing persistent semantic-to-spatial correspondences for consistent fusion control across viewpoints. Second, Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance (LCGA) is developed to achieve scene-wide multimodal appearance modeling by combining adaptive multimodal blending with language- and viewpoint-conditioned appearance refinement, enabling spatially adaptive realization of diverse fusion appearances while preserving source fidelity at pure-modality endpoints. Finally, we construct a Multi-View Language-Supervision (MVLS) dataset that associates language instructions and calibrated viewpoints with modulated fused images, providing effective supervision for learning instruction-dependent fusion from finite multi-view observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIFT achieves coherent multimodal fusion across continuous viewpoints, accurate semantic target localization, and consistent regional fusion control under diverse language instructions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LIFT 框架与「语言控制的 3D 图像融合」任务，用语言指令定位语义目标及其模态偏好并绑定到共享 Gaussian 场景，再以语言与视角为条件做自适应多模态外观混合，并构建多视角语言监督数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语言指令→持久语义-空间对应→按需选择模态与区域」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的定位、筛选与跨视角一致保留提供一种表示层面的参照；但工作本身不做推理与答案生成，可供核查的具体线索有限。
